questions.question: In which film does Humphrey Bogart say, “Here’s looking at you, kid”?
questions.note: He says it more than once to Ingrid Bergman’s Ilsa.

questions.question: Which film introduced the line “May the Force be with you”?
choices: Close Encounters of the Third Kind
questions.note: The 1977 original, later subtitled A New Hope.

questions.question: In which film does Arnold Schwarzenegger say, “I’ll be back”?
questions.note: He walks into a police station first — then comes back through the wall.

questions.question: Which film includes the courtroom outburst “You can’t handle the truth!”?
questions.note: Jack Nicholson’s Colonel Jessup, opposite Tom Cruise.

questions.question: In which film is the line “I’m going to make him an offer he can’t refuse”?
questions.note: Don Vito Corleone, explaining how “business” gets done.

questions.question: Which film popularized the line “Houston, we have a problem”?
questions.note: The real radio call was slightly different; the movie made this wording famous.

questions.question: Which film includes the line “I see dead people”?
questions.note: Haley Joel Osment, whispering to Bruce Willis.

questions.question: In which film does the Joker ask, “Why so serious?”?
questions.note: Heath Ledger’s Joker, in Christopher Nolan’s 2008 Batman film.

questions.question: Which film includes the line “Nobody puts Baby in a corner”?
questions.note: Patrick Swayze’s Johnny, about Jennifer Grey’s Frances “Baby” Houseman.

questions.question: Which film includes the line “Life is like a box of chocolates”?
questions.note: Mama Gump’s advice, as told by Tom Hanks.
